title: Snow Atlas SaaS Application
description: Schema for Snow Atlas SaaS application objects including KPIs, subscriptions, and user data

id.description: Unique identifier for the SaaS application

category.description: SaaS application category (e.g., Productivity, Security, CRM)

status.description: Management status of the SaaS application

discoverySource.description: How the SaaS application was discovered (e.g., SSO, email, web traffic)

totalUsers.description: Total number of users with access to the application

activeUsers.description: Number of users who actively used the application in the period

annualSpend.description: Annual spend on the application in the org's default currency

subscriptions.description: Subscription contracts associated with the application

kpis.description: Key performance indicators for the application

utilizationRate.description: Percentage of licensed seats actively used

unusedLicenses.description: Number of purchased licenses not actively used

potentialSavings.description: Estimated savings from right-sizing unused licenses
